result.summary: The UI is mostly polished but exhibits minor layout and content consistency issues.

issues.description: The 'Order now' button in the top promo banner has uneven vertical padding, appearing too close to the bottom edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the button's vertical alignment to be centered within its designated area in the banner.

issues.description: Redundant delivery fee information is present on the 'Popular right now' cards, appearing as both a badge and text.
issues.suggestion: Consolidate the delivery fee information into a single location to reduce visual clutter.
